Internal Maintainer Notes ​

This directory contains maintainer-internal workflow notes, planning specs, and historical cleanup artifacts.

Normal contributors do not need to read these files to contribute to RustChat.

For public contribution guidance, see:

  • CONTRIBUTING.md
  • docs/development/testing.md
  • GOVERNANCE.md

These files are retained for maintainer continuity and project history. They should not be treated as user-facing product documentation.
